rss: US inflation rises more than expected ahead of midterm elections
title: Prices Go Up, Buying Gets Harder
story: Things like fuel and toys are costing more lately. This means kids might need to save up more of their allowance to buy the toys they want.
storyBig: Inflation has increased by 3.7%, driven by higher fuel costs. This affects the purchasing power of consumers, as goods across the board become more expensive.
think: How does saving money help when prices go up?
bull: Saving money can help you buy the things you need.
bear: Rising prices might mean you can't buy as much as before.

rss: Wayfair among firms fined millions for misleading sales tactics
title: Toy Store Tricks Customers, Gets Fined
story: A big toy store got in trouble for misleading kids about sales. They have to pay a fine and be honest from now on.
storyBig: A toy company was fined for using misleading sales tactics. This raises questions about consumer trust and the importance of honest advertising.
think: Why is it important for stores to be honest about prices?
bull: Honest stores make shopping easier and more fun.
bear: Unfair pricing tricks can make shopping confusing.
